messages:
julia: Heads up — seeing a p95 spike hitting ~320ms on the inference tier during the prefill ramp at 08:12 UTC. Suspect warm-pool prefetch/backfill is stalling.
ken: Which route/models? any recent deploys? :eyes:
julia: Mostly prod-text-gen routes, model xlarge 8k. We flipped joiner hysteresis and a small batching tick in last night's deploy (rev b3a). p50 fine, p95/p99 up.
ops-bot: [ALERT] autoscale: warm-pool-prefill-delay detected (service=inference, region=us-west2)
mira: Can you paste kernel selection trace from the slow host? might be falling back to a non-optimized kernel when KV cache misses spike.
julia: quick logs:
```
08:12:03 warm-prefill start pool_id=wp-22
08:12:03 kv-prefetch req=1024 ms=0.9 hit=false
08:12:04 kernel-select model=xlarge seq=1024 -> fallback=slow_attention
08:12:04 start-infer gpu=0 task=abcd
08:12:04 finish-infer ms=310
```
sam: Oof 310ms per request during warmup. Are these warm-pool containers waiting on image pull or on KV warmup?
alex: I checked node-47 (one of the warm pool hosts) — disk IO was saturated, lots of container restarts from oomkill earlier. dmesg showed `blk_update_request: I/O error` spikes around 08:10.
ken: That could explain slow KV load from disk, leading to misses and kernel fallback. Any noisy neighbor evidence (other tenant consuming PCIe or host IO)?
mira: Profiler snippet from the slow job (truncated):
```
kernel_choice: fallback slow_attention
kv_prefetch: miss_count=87 miss_latency_p95=220ms
batcher: queued=1->8 join_wait=45ms
gpu_util: 12% (wait_io=70ms)
```
julia: So GPU underutil but waiting on IO. Batcher increases wait to try to pack, higher join_wait leads to p95 blowup.
sam: Rollback joiner hysteresis? That was intended to reduce small-batch overhead but maybe backfired during prefills.
ken: I'm seeing a spike in container image pull latencies for that region earlier — registry had transient 503s. Combine that with degraded node disk -> slower startup + KV miss = cascade.
alex: Also saw kernel selection heuristic falling back because measured sequence length distribution briefly exceeded the precomputed threshold; sequence length probe returns 0 for some early requests (KV empty) -> selects conservative kernel.
mira: Quick mitigation suggestions:
- bump warm-pool target by +20% for next 30m
- disable the new joiner hysteresis roll (revert rev b3a)
- temp allow aggressive kernel pinning for xlarge so we use optimized kernel even if KV hits are low
sam: I'll queue a rollback for the joiner change (oncall) and scale warm-pool now.
julia: Doing a temporary config: `prefill.backoff_ms=50 -> 20` and `autopool.target=+20%` (pushed)
ken: I'll also block image pulls to nodes with IO errors and rotate them out of pool.
mira: After mitigation, p95 dropped to ~55ms within 6 minutes. Need root cause: why disk IO flared + registry 503s simultaneously.
alex: I've opened a ticket with infra to surface host-level noisy neighbor (possibly backup job) and registry team to check 08:00–08:20 window.
ops-bot: [ACTION] follow-up: assign infra-ticket #INF-2918 and registry-ticket #REG-7642 — owners required to post RCA.
julia: Postmortem owners: infra (ken), runtime perf (mira), deploy (sam). I'll capture metrics and traces and add to the incident doc.
sam: TL;DR — cascade: registry hiccup + host IO thrash -> KV warm miss spike -> kernel fallback + increased joiner wait -> autoscale/warmpool perceived cold starts -> p95 spike. Fixes: revert joiner change, scale warm pool, rotate bad nodes, pin kernels short-term.
julia: Thanks all, keeping thread open for RCA notes. :thumbsup:
